title: Kiritani Haruka — A Street-style Idol?!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for agreeing to this, Haruka. I know you must be tired from practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't mind me. I'm sure you're tired too, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, I've been wanting to look at the digital album Kohane made for us with you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, shall we take a look?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's see. Where'd I put my phone?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I knew that Kohane liked photography, but I didn't realize how good she was at editing photos and putting together albums like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, she said that she asked her dad to teach her how to make digital albums.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She learned all that just for us?
I'll have to thank her when I see her at school tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The first picture is...
Oh, it's us having dessert at the diner.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're right! Those were so yummy too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Kohane was really regretting not taking pictures of you trying on clothes at that street fashion place.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But she had to make sure not to because it's usually against store policy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad she thought I looked good in that outfit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Of course you looked good!
Conversely, is there anything you don't look good in?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What? I really don't think that's the case.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you sure? I would've taken as many pictures of you as I could have if I was allowed to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'll never forget what I saw that day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm...? Are these stickers in the background?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh wow! They're stars and hearts! That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's so cool! I didn't know you could edit photos like this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me neither. These do a really nice job of showing how fun that was too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I think these are the ones from Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, look! This is when we went on the merry-go-round together, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also... I think she took these in continuous mode. Look, it's like we're moving frame by frame.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like Kohane's a professional photographer!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She just might be. She captured all these great expressions too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She must have a talent for picturing people in the best light possible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka, look at this one!
It's the cutout where you can be Phenny!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Haha... Oh geez...
I look like I'm in my own little world...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. But you're making such a cute face.
Great choice, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Does this mean I was able to relax a little?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The face I'm making here's really embarrassing, but it looks like I was genuinely enjoying myself...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, our stream or anything of the sort came up much during conversations when I was with them.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Whenever I'm by myself, I seem to naturally gravitate towards my idol persona...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I feel like I can just be myself when I'm around An.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I guess it's because she knows the real me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No, it isn't just that...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? Haruka, is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I was just thinking that I must've been able to really relax based on the face I'm making here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I have you and the others to thank for giving me that opportunity, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm really happy that I got to hear more from An about Haruka Kiritani before she became an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's something I'll never ever forget both as your fan and as your friend!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I suppose that means you're the reason I was able to have so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you're my dear friend too, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: On our way home that day, you mentioned how you didn't know anything about me before I became an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if you think about it, An doesn't really know much about me after I'd become one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Instead, someone right under my nose was doing her best to learn as much as she could about me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That person's you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And you want to know more about me than anybody else, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I'm gonna do everything I can! I'll follow you wherever and learn absolutely everything about you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Every time she says that...
It makes my heart tickle...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And I couldn't be happier...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't thank you enough, Minori.
